Hi Lena / Ayesha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — appreciated the frank questions. Quick recap and two asks so we can move this forward on your timeline:

Recap (1 min):
- Showed a short pilot flow (2-node inference, latency targets, prefix caching) and cost scenarios for a 6mo pilot.
- Discussed data residency and SOC2 scope as gating items for production.
- Team seemed aligned on value: better latency for the inference tier, predictable spend with Redwood Dedicated.

Asks:
1) Decision heatmap: could you share the list of people who make the final call and what they care about? e.g. econ buyer (finance), security owner, procurement lead, legal reviewer. If helpful, a 1-page org chart or an internal contact map is perfect.
2) Procurement & legal steps: what intake forms or vendor questionnaire does NovaCare use? Any required SLAs or contractual redlines we should know up-front?

I attached the demo notes and a short one-pager on pilot scope. If it's easier, we can also take an action to have a 20-minute sync with your econ buyer to align on success criteria and procurement timeline. Does next Tue or Wed morning (your time) work?

Thanks — I’ll coordinate follow-ups from our side.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
(redwood-demo-notes.pdf attached)

Monica — thanks for the clear recap. Forwarding to Tom and procurement to answer the intake/form question. Quick notes from our side:

- Decision criteria we care about: total cost of ownership (TCO) over 12 months, tail latency at p99 for inference, data residency (US-only for PHI-adjacent datasets), and vendor audit trail/SOC2 status.
- Internal sponsors: Ayesha Khan (SVP, Finance) will sign off on spend; technical champion is me; Legal (Tom) and Procurement will own contract and onboarding.

I attached a simple org chart showing the-payors and ops leads — hopefully that helps for mapping.

Thanks for the note. We use a standard vendor onboarding packet and a short procurement questionnaire. I attached the form and included the timelines below:

- Contract negotiation window: typically 2-3 weeks once legal has the initial redlines.
- PO issuance: after finance sign-off and countersigned contract.
